title: Les drops de Q à l'épreuve des faits : étude statistique des messages de « Q » (2017-2022) / Q drops against the facts
description:
Pipeline and bilingual (FR/EN) website for a statistical study of the 4,966 "Q" drops (QAnon, 2017-2022): activity, discourse, actors, Trump tweets, world news (GDELT), public interest, automatically extracted and individually verified predictions, horoscope test, bibliography of verified references.

Website: https://s-geffroy.github.io/QAnon/
